signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a single-story house with tan siding, partly obscured by a large tree in the foreground. It is a corner-lot view with a driveway on the left, so the front facade is not visible.
signals.notes: This is a side view of a corner-lot ranch house with fallen leaves on the lawn; a blue car is parked on the neighboring street far in the background, and the front entrance is not visible.
